name: Hanweir Militia Captain // Westvale Cult Leader

faces.name: Hanweir Militia Captain
faces.text: At the beginning of your upkeep, if you control four or more creatures, transform this creature.

faces.name: Westvale Cult Leader
faces.text:
Westvale Cult Leader's power and toughness are each equal to the number of creatures you control.
At the beginning of your end step, create a 1/1 white and black Human Cleric creature token.
